response.rationale: In this rink booking app, InMemoryBookingRepository.listBySession(sessionId) (src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts) returns the bookings that belong to a session. RinkService (src/business/rinkService.ts, node 21c65604dec116b1) injects SessionStore and BookingStore and creates sessions with `this.sessions.create({`. The session that bookings are made against is therefore most likely the skating session, under a shorter name. Nothing suggests a second kind of session, such as a user login session. Caveat: the shared type definition isn't visible, so this match is inferred from names and usage.
